messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer SUP-5421 reporting intermittent 429s from /v1/rerank after today's deploy. They batch ~250 candidates per call. Response headers show X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, and we're getting immediate 429s with no Retry-After header. Anyone seen this pattern?
sophia: can you paste a request id + a minimal sample payload? rerank billing is candidate-weighted so big lists can explode quota quickly.
alex: req_id=01H9ABCDX. Sample payload they used:
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "best nearby restaurants for outdoor seating",
  "candidates": ["id1","id2", ... ,"id250"]
}
```
They also reported some responses with scores like NaN or -inf.
priya: noted. quick note: depending on the model, rerank cost is proportional to candidate_count (pairwise/comparisons), so 250 candidates can mean tens of thousands of internal ops. That will spike our candidate-count quota and QPS. NaNs usually come from float overflow in the old pairwise scorer when inputs are long.
alex: spike correlates with ~20 concurrent calls from the same API key.
sophia: do the 429 responses include X-RateLimit-Reset or Retry-After? we should surface Retry-After when throttling is returned.
alex: headers we captured: X-RateLimit-Limit: 6000, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, X-RateLimit-Reset: 1743338000. No Retry-After header.
priya: thanks — I've created SUP-5421 and escalated to eng-infra. Repro steps for infra team:
1) send 20 concurrent rerank calls with 250 candidates each
2) observe 429 after ~2m
curl snippet to repro:
```bash
for i in {1..20}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d @payload.json &
done
wait
```
infra-bot: deploy 'rerank-rate-limiter-tuning' rolled at 2024-05-03T15:12Z to canary nodes.
oncall: digging into rate-limiter logs — we see a surge of candidate-count weighted tokens. Limiter treats rerank as candidate-weighted units rather than per-request; the missing Retry-After is a bug when we take the "hard limit" path. Raising an alert and creating a short-lived workaround to emit Retry-After. :eyes:
priya: short-term mitigation for customers: reduce candidates to <=100, add client-side exponential backoff, or pre-filter candidates server-side. We'll offer SUP-5421 a temporary quota bump and enable server-side smoothing for their key. :white_check_mark:
sophia: added an input validation change to reject payloads that would yield NaN scores with a 400 + reason "score-overflow". That avoids silent fallbacks.
alex: customer confirmed that reducing candidate list to 80 removed the 429s. Leaving ticket open until infra fix deployed and Retry-After bug patched.
priya: PR #4821 created in eng-infra to (1) emit Retry-After on hard-limit path, (2) add smoothing for candidate-weighted quotas, (3) add logging for NaN score reasons. ETA EOD tomorrow. I'll update docs with guidance on candidate limits and the candidate-cost model.
